operations.title: Entry 1153 conditionally closes the integral cusp branch under frozen sources
operations.body: Entry 1153 is verified after auditing arXiv:2408.16386 and its directly relevant contour sources 2401.05207 and 2402.06558. They provide contour positivity, de Rham masters, PF degeneration, residues, and asymptotics, but no integral Betti/Gysin basis or parity of twice an elliptic lift. The main paper explicitly says boundary conditions are independent input. Thus all four Entry 1152 classes remain open; visible full-lattice Z/2 is neither proved nor disproved. This branch should remain frozen until an independently normalized integral Picard-Lefschetz/Gysin packet exists.
